# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: ...So this "power of the armor" is no more than this...
The armor's power has nothing to do with it!!
Well, do your best to survive, powerless white $$羽$$.
A word of advice to you powerless white $$羽$$.
Damn it!!
Killing the likes of you would be easy.
I have no interest in your foolish way of thinking, but...
so long as you pursue it, you cannot avoid a clash with him.
(He knows the upper ranks of the $$教団$$!?)
But merely seeking the same power I possess will not let you defeat him.
The power you possess, yet have not seen...
Understand that power.
(...That fellow...)
(...What is he saying?)
When you defeat him in my stead...
I'll kill you myself.
Damn it all!!
(Why is he so fixated on an armor of this caliber...)
(Perhaps it might be interesting to watch how this era unfolds...)
You bastard!! Quit looking away!!
Hey, I've been looking forward to meeting you!!
...The $$教団$$ has grown weak indeed, if it cannot even contain power of this degree...
What did you say!?
Why must someone with power like yours obey them?
Obey?
Heh. In the age when I lived, I never heard a word like that...
That too is the tide of the ages, I suppose...
The ages...?
(Why is he so fixated on an armor of this caliber...)
